proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Termination Pay
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Board seek shareholder approval for any senior manager pay package providing severance or termination payments exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target short-term bonus.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Abortion & Consumer Data Privacy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on risks and costs of fulfilling law enforcement requests for customer data related to enforcement of state abortion-criminalizing laws, and mitigation strategies, by September 1, 2024.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
